second_look.headline: Microsoft says months-old bug caused global Microsoft 365 outage
second_look.angle: Microsoft’s global Microsoft 365 outage knocked Copilot and other core services offline, leaving users unable to access email and disrupting message delivery worldwide.
second_look.quote: The nearly 24-hour outage on November 12 disrupted Microsoft 365 services worldwide , including Outlook, Exchange Online, Teams, and Copilot, leaving users unable to access their email and causing significant delays in message delivery.
